FURINA_CARD_REUNION.description:

Replay the last Attack, Skill, and Power card you played.

FURINA_CARD_MASQUERADE.description:
Draw 2 cards.
At the start of your next {MasqueradePower:diff()} turns, draw 2 cards.
If you draw fewer than 10 cards in a turn, die.
{IfUpgraded:show:|This turn, }all cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] cost 1 less Energy the next time they are played. Exhaust.

 Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], {Repeat:diff()} times.When you upgrade another card, this card also upgrades.
